snapshot_next_report.first_output:
The AI compute theme dominated your watchlist today, with TSM, NVDA and AVGO all up 2.1% to 2.8% while AMD lagged, falling 0.2%. That's a meaningful split inside the group, though no headline is attached to AMD's divergence. Elsewhere in semiconductors, the memory and storage names split dramatically company by company -- WDC and STX jumped 5.6% and 4.6% respectively, while SNDK and MU both fell around 1%. Hard drive names breaking away from memory chips suggests something sector-specific rather than broad semiconductor momentum. Mega-cap tech moved broadly higher, led by TSLA and META each up around 2%, though AAPL slipped 0.3% against its peers. CEG stood out in the power and infrastructure group, up 4.1% while the rest of that theme held near flat.

Outside your list, Brazilian fintech names ran hard -- XP, INTR, STNE and PAGS all up 20% to 32% -- and PTC jumped 34%, both appearing on the day's most active and biggest gainers lists. Those moves are large enough to be merger-related or driven by specific company news rather than broad market forces, though no headlines explain them here.

TSM reports in ten days. TSLA and VRT both report in sixteen days, followed by STX at twenty-two days and a cluster at twenty-three to twenty-four days: META, MSFT, GOOGL, AAPL, AMZN, SNDK and GEV.
